provenance.relationship: Implementing assistant; not independent human review
provenance.blinding: Unblinded; arm names and aggregate execution counts were visible.
provenance.method: All 120 final question/record/answer pairs reviewed using the pre-frozen public-v1 rubric. Separate support/completeness judgments; no label inferred from gate acceptance.
provenance.scope: The appended synthetic reference identifies the payment under discussion. Explanations of earlier attempts or account-wide status are not inferred from that record. Indirect complaints require subjective interpretation. Status definitions describe schema semantics, not verified external bank policy.
provenance.refusals: The three baseline missing-reason refusals are supported and complete evidence-limited answers, although requesting an already supplied ID is a usability flaw.
